name: acme-expenses
description: Companion code for Coding with Claude: A Developer's Playbook

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @acme/api && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-acme --ui "npm run dev -w @acme/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @acme/api && npm run build -w @acme/web
scripts.test: vitest run --project shared --project api --project web --project mcp
scripts.test:emu: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-acme "vitest run --project api-emu && vitest run --project rules"
